label: Where
value: Thal, Upper Dir District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
quote: The Jamia Masjid of Thal is a mosque located in Upper Dir District of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province in Pakistan.

label: Getting there
value: The gateway to the Kumrat valley, in Upper Dir district
quote: the gateway to the picturesque Kumrat valley in Upper Dir district
source: The News International (M. Daud Jan, 5 Jan 2020)

label: History
value: Built 1865; a fire in 1950 partly damaged it
quote: This mosque was originally built in 1865. In 1950, there was a fire in this mosque, which partially damaged the mosque.

label: Material
quote: The specialty of this mosque is that it is made of pure wood

label: Pillars
value: Big wooden pillars carried by local people on their shoulders
quote: big wooden pillars carried by the local people on their shoulders were used in the construction of the mosque
source: The News International (M. Daud Jan, 5 Jan 2020)

label: Floors
value: Work on the second floor began in 1998; construction took about nine years
quote: In 1998, the work on the second floor of the mosque started, and the construction of the mosque was completed in about nine years.

label: The view
value: Lush green fields around the mosque, seen from the second floor
quote: The eye-catching scenery of lush green fields in the surroundings can be seen from the second floor of the mosque.
source: The News International (M. Daud Jan, 5 Jan 2020)
